'''April 2001 Knoxville tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Knoxville Gaming Bureau (KGB), Knoxville, TN on 8 April 2001. [[Jon Tomayko]] won it. It is known from Matt Mathison's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2067">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-14-knoxville-tn-4-8-01d2067/ knoxville-tn-4-8-01], DeckTech (Matt "Furry Fury" Mathison, 14 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-14-knoxville-tn-4-8-01d2067/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 8 April 2001
* '''Site:''' Knoxville Gaming Bureau (KGB), Knoxville, TN
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 9
* '''Winner:''' [[Jon Tomayko]]
